findings.title: Validation error message leaks raw input
findings.body: The error message on line 8 includes the raw input `raw` via an f-string, which can expose sensitive data (e.g., passwords, tokens) in logs or error responses. Use the cleaned value `cleaned` instead to avoid leaking the original input.

summary.problem: The new email normalization adds validation but leaks raw input in error messages, risking exposure of sensitive data.
summary.done_well: The change improves correctness by validating email format and maintaining the canonical key behavior.
